CLINICAL STUDY PROTOCOL
Protocol ID: BIO-2026-PHASE3

Section 1: Primary Objectives
The primary objective is to evaluate efficacy and safety of Compound-712.
Patients will receive standardized oral dosing once daily over 24 weeks.
1.1 Patient Eligibility Criteria
- Age 18 to 75 years inclusive at time of screening;
- Confirmed diagnostic indication according to ICD-11 guidelines;
- Normal liver and renal biomarker function at baseline.
Section 2: Multi-Arm Dosing Schedule
Treatment Arm Dosage Frequency Duration
Arm A - Active 50 mg Daily 24 Weeks
Arm B - Active 100 mg Daily 24 Weeks
Arm C - Placebo 0 mg Daily 24 Weeks

Adverse Event Monitoring
Clinical safety reviews occur at Weeks 2, 4, 8, 12, and 24.
Section 3: Statistical Methodology
Statistical analyses will follow intent-to-treat principles.
Continuous variables will be summarized using mean and standard deviation.
Categorical data will be evaluated using Fisher exact test comparisons.
Interim monitoring will be conducted by an independent Data Safety Board.
